answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 1392 Country: India Title: Can any one offer prayer in urgency behind bidathis? and what about gair muqallideens? Question: Can any one offer prayer in urgency behind bidathis? and what about gair muqallideens? Answer ID: 1392 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 386/386=L) If the beliefs of the Bidati (innovator in religion) do not amount to Kufr (infidelity) then the salah behind him will be valid but Makrooh Tahreemi (highly undesirable): ان کان ھوی لایکفر بہ صاحبہ تجوز الصلاۃ خلفہ مع الکراھۃ و الا فلا (عالمگیری:1/84) (2) If they are not terming Taqleed as Shirk , are not abusing the Imams and pious predecessors and take care of Hanafi Fiqh in leading the s alah then one can offer salah behind them: والرابع عشر شروط صحۃ الاقتداء ان لا یعلم المقتدی من حال امام المخالف لمذھبہ مفسداً فی زعم المأموم یعنی فی مذھب المأموم کخروج دم ساءل او قئ یملأ الفم (طحطاوی علی مراقی الفلاح: 160) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
